label: Tulum
note: Ripened in an animal skin (tulum), the method that gives it its name. Other skin-packed cheeses exist too, such as Greek touloumotyri.

about.text: Tulum cheese is a traditional Turkish goat's milk cheese ripened in a goatskin casing, called tulum in Turkish.
